runs.t: Our Vision of a Responsible Future

Throughout this report, we have demonstrated how clarity of purpose translates into disciplined action. By setting transparent goals, aligning capital with measurable outcomes, and embedding ESG principles across our platforms, EFG Holding ensures that sustainability is not aspirational, but operational. Our ESG strategy reflects a holistic and integrated approach to sustainable value creation, anchored in strong environmental stewardship, meaningful social investment, and robust governance practices. Across its operations, the Firm continues to align financial performance with environmental responsibility by advancing green financing solutions and actively managing its environmental footprint through digitalization, efficiency measures, and emissions tracking.

At the same time, EFG Holding reinforces its commitment to inclusive growth by expanding access to finance, investing in healthcare and education, and supporting community development through targeted initiatives. These efforts demonstrate the Firm’s role not only as a financial institution, but as a driver of broader socio-economic progress.

Underpinning these pillars is a strong governance framework that promotes ethical conduct, transparency, and accountability, while embedding ESG considerations across business lines and functions. The integration of advanced technologies further enhances oversight, risk management, and decision-making capabilities. Together, these efforts position EFG Holding to navigate evolving market expectations, contribute to sustainable development, and deliver long-term value to its stakeholders.

As we move forward, clarity will remain our guiding principle. Clear priorities, transparent reporting, and measurable performance will continue to shape our strategy and strengthen stakeholder trust. In doing so, EFG Holding reaffirms that sustainable growth is built on openness, responsibility, and the consistent delivery of real, demonstrable progress.
